words.def: matching or consistent with something, such as a standard, market level or policy.
words.book: I feel that a salary between ___ and ___ is in line with the industry average and reflects my skills and experience level well.
uses: Email
Our maintenance rates are in line with the market for 80 kVA UPS systems.
Chat
is this discount in line with the pricing policy?
Meeting
The new payment terms are in line with what we agreed with finance.
dont: The price is suitable with the market.
doo: The price is in line with the market.

words.def: extra benefits you get from a job besides salary, like a car, phone or training.
words.book: Your training programs, the commuter benefits and other perks could definitely allow me to be a bit flexible with salary.
uses: Email
The package includes a company car, mobile allowance and other perks.
Chat
one of the perks of the service team: free lunch on site visits 😄
Meeting
Let's talk about perks — is there a transportation allowance?
goes: a company car and other perks
dont: The job has additional advantages besides the money.
doo: The job comes with some nice perks.

words.ar: منافس / في مستوى السوق أو أحسن
words.def: as good as or better than what others offer, especially about prices or salaries.
words.book: I'm confident that you're offering a salary that's competitive in the current market.
uses: Email
Please find attached our most competitive offer for the 40 kW solar system.
Chat
can we give them a more competitive price on the batteries?
Meeting
Our service contract is very competitive compared to the other vendors.

words.def: the process of helping a new employee or customer get started and settled in.
words.book: Can you describe your onboarding process?
uses: Email
Your onboarding will include a two-day workshop on UPS installation and safety.
Chat
onboarding the new client tomorrow — can you prep the site checklist?
Meeting
Good onboarding means new engineers can visit sites alone after a month.
dont: What is the program of receiving new employees?
doo: What does the onboarding process look like?

words.def: numbers used to measure performance or progress.
words.book: What metrics or goals would you use to evaluate my performance?
uses: Email
Key metrics this month: response time, first-time fix rate and collections.
Chat
what metrics does the boss care about most?
Meeting
We track two metrics for the service team: response time and customer satisfaction.
dont: How will you measure me with numbers?
doo: What metrics will you use to measure my performance?

words.book: He told me that the culture here is top-notch, and that management supports continuing education and learning on the job while rewarding hard work.
uses: Email
The client said our after-sales service was top-notch.
Chat
the new server room looks top-notch 🔥
Meeting
We need top-notch technicians for the data-centre contract.

pro: I'm looking for somewhere between 10,000 and 12,000, depending on the overall package.
upgrade.why: إدي نطاق (‎range‎) مش رقم ناشف، واربطه بالـ‎package‎.

upgrade.plain: How much is the salary of this job?
pro: Could you give me an idea of the salary range for this position?
How much is the salary of this job?
upgrade.why: ‎Could you give me an idea of‎ أهدى وأشيك من السؤال المباشر.

upgrade.plain: I can accept less money if there are other advantages.
upgrade.ar: ممكن أقبل فلوس أقل لو فيه مزايا تانية
pro: I accept less money if advantages.
Benefits matter to me as well, so I'm open to negotiating based on the entire package.
Less money is OK if other things.
upgrade.why: استخدم ‎benefits‎ و‎the entire package‎ عشان تفاوض بذكاء.

upgrade.plain: I love your company too much.
pro: I love your company too much.
I've always been a fan of your products and your focus on quality.
Your company is very very good.
upgrade.why: ‎too much‎ معناها زيادة عن اللزوم. قول ليه معجب بالشركة.

upgrade.plain: How will you know I am good in the job?
upgrade.ar: هتعرفوا إزاي إني كويس في الشغل؟
pro: How you know I am good?
How will you know I am good in the job?
What is the most important indicator of success in this position?
upgrade.why: ‎indicator of success‎ سؤال مهني بيبين إنك مهتم بالنتايج.

upgrade.plain: I don't have number, give me what you want.
upgrade.ar: مفيش رقم في دماغي، إدوني اللي انتوا عايزينه
pro: I don't have a specific figure in mind, so I'm willing to consider an offer you feel is fair.
I don't have number, give me what you want.
Any money is OK for me.
upgrade.why: ‎a specific figure‎ و‎an offer you feel is fair‎ بتحافظ على موقفك.
